correctness.rationale: The exact defect update d_i(t+1)=d_i(t)-2h_i(t)+h_(i-1)(t)+h_(i-2)(t) reconstructs all synchronous firing supports. Induction gives two-coordinate advancing nonfiring blocks and explicitly handles the wrap for odd and even n and both q values. The first repeat is derived, so all later supports are accounted for. Partitioned excluded blocks give the boundary nerve of a k-simplex and hence an integral S^(k-1); the even q=0 case has a redundant last facet and a literal common-vertex cone. Every earlier stage is a cone, which fixes all persistent maps. verify.py checked 476 actual or translated orbits and 80 mod-two direct filtration-stage homology computations. No finite test is claimed to prove the infinite theorem.

value.rationale: The new 2026 avalanche-homology framework explicitly asks for other graph families and structural persistence phenomena. The first nontrivial circulant extension of the directed cycle displays an exact parity threshold and a one-grain change from a cone to a sphere in arbitrarily high dimensions without any full firing round. The precise nontrivial birth time produces an all-field persistence benchmark and isolates a dynamic boundary mechanism distinct from the simple-cycle all-firing collapse.
